title: The Athletic Says Dianna Russini’s Relationship With Mike Vrabel Violated Its Standards
summary: The New York Times-owned publication said the relationship between its former reporter Dianna Russini and Mike Vrabel of the Patriots gave the appearance of a conflict of interest.
